summary: The customer called to complain about a delayed refund for a cancelled internet installation kit order. The agent identified the issue as a failure in the automated system, manually processed the refund of one hundred and fifty dollars, and informed the customer of the processing timeframe.

evidence.text: The refund of one hundred and fifty dollars has been initiated to your original payment method.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Initiate a manual refund of 150 dollars to the customer's original payment method.

evidence.text: You will also receive a confirmation email shortly.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Send a confirmation email regarding the refund.

evidence.text: I certainly understand your frustration regarding the delayed refund. Let me pull up your account to check the status.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent remained polite, calm, and professional throughout the call despite the customer's frustration.

evidence.text: I certainly understand your frustration regarding the delayed refund.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration promptly and sincerely.

evidence.text: I am processing it manually for you right now, sir.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully resolved the issue by manually processing the refund that failed in the automated system.

evidence.text: It typically takes three to five business days to reflect in your account.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent communicated the timeline and resolution clearly without using confusing jargon.

evidence.text: Thank you for your patience, have a good day.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The call ended politely with a closing statement, though the customer hung up abruptly.

evidence.text: It looks like the system didn't automatically trigger the refund when the cancellation went through.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately identified the root cause of the missing refund by checking the account.

evidence.text: May I have your account number or phone number, please?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper procedure by verifying the account using the phone number before discussing account details.

quote.text: Look, I cancelled my internet installation kit order two weeks ago and I still haven't seen my refund.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: It's 555-0198. And I don't want excuses, I want to know where my one hundred and fifty dollars is.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: That is ridiculous! Why is that my problem? Just process it right this second.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: How long is this actually going to take to hit my bank account?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Fine. It better be there in three days. Goodbye.
quote.speaker: Customer
